shadows.name: ambient-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on cards and buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a3462a; color: #faf6f0; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; border: none; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7e341e; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(42,36,32,0.08), 0 16px 32px rgba(163,70,42,0.10); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8b7a3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #2a2420; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #d3c7b5; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f2ebe1; }

components.name: Content Card
components.html:
Sector

Business Leaders

Equipping managers and executives to lead with integrity.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #f2ebe1; border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(42,36,32,0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(42,36,32,0.06); } .ds-card-label { color: #a3462a; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2a2420; margin: 8px 0; } .ds-card-body { color: #5c5349; line-height: 1.65; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Primary navigation link with grow-in underline active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: #5c5349; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 4px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; right: 50%; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: #a3462a; transition: left 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), right 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page']::after { left: 0; right: 0; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #2a2420; }

components.name: Tag Badge
components.description: Small pill badge, the one place pill radius is allowed.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; background: #e8b7a3; color: #7e341e; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: An editorial, warm-earth identity for an organization that keeps real records of real people: names, cities, sectors, board members. The system reads like a well-kept ledger bound in clay-red cloth: confident serif headlines, generous cream space, one deep terracotta accent used sparingly to mark what matters. It rejects the cool navy-and-gold institutional template look the site currently wears, which reads as a generic downloaded NGO theme rather than a specific organization.
keyCharacteristics: One confident accent (deep terracotta clay), never more than ~10% of any screen's surface.
Warm tinted neutrals throughout; no pure white, no pure black anywhere.
Serif display type for gravity and warmth; workhorse sans for body text.
Arabic and English are two native executions of one system, not a mirrored reskin.
Real photography from public/images/ replaces icon grids and emoji wherever a concrete image exists.

rules.name: The One Ledger-Mark Rule
rules.body: Clay appears in at most one place per section: the CTA, or the eyebrow label, or the active nav underline, never two at once.

rules.name: No Pure Rule
rules.body: Never #fff or #000 or Tailwind gray-*. Every neutral is warm-tinted from the sand/ink ramp.

rules.name: The No Font-Swap Rule
rules.body: Arabic is never the English scale with Rubik substituted in. Line-height, base size, and weight are tuned per-script.

rules.name: The Gentle Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows only deepen in response to hover/focus state; nothing sits under a heavy shadow at rest.

dos: Do use clay (#a3462a) in exactly one role per section.
Do give Arabic its own type scale: larger line-height, heavier default weight.
Do mirror layout direction for RTL: flex/grid order, icon direction, text-align, logical margin/padding.
Do use real photography from public/images/ instead of generic icon grids.
Do keep shadows soft and hover-triggered.
donts: Don't use gradient hero blobs, gradient text, or default glassmorphism.
Don't build icons-in-circles feature grids or hero-metric-stat-card blocks.
Don't use emoji as functional UI icons.
Don't use rounded-full pill shape on primary/secondary action buttons.
Don't use pure white/black or Tailwind default gray-*.
Don't treat Arabic as English with dir="rtl" and a font swap.
Don't stack border + shadow + heavy radius on the same card.
Don't reuse stock team high-fiving or corporate-megachurch photography style.
